page.heading: One number, real people
body: Your staff call, email, chat or open a ticket in the client portal. A technician answers, not a phone menu. During business hours our average first response on a ticket is 12 minutes.

Most problems are fixed remotely while you watch. If something needs hands on it, like a dead laptop or a printer that will not talk to anyone, we book a visit. We keep notes on every device and every user, so nobody has to explain the same thing twice.

We also handle the routine work that falls between the cracks. New hires get a laptop, accounts and access ready on their first morning. When someone leaves, their access is closed the same day and their files are handed to the right person.
Support covers everyone on your team and every device they use for work. We do not count tickets or charge by the call.

faq.q: What hours is the help desk open?
faq.a: Monday to Friday, 7:00 to 19:00, by phone, email, chat and the portal. Outside those hours, urgent problems go to the on-call technician.
Yes. The help desk takes calls and tickets in English and French.

faq.q: Do you support Macs and phones?
faq.a: Yes. We support Windows, macOS, iPhone and Android devices used for work.
